text: Evening. Writing about my stepdaughter Ellie who is 2 years old. She's had a temprature since yesterday afternoon and its 39.2 tonight, I took it under her arm and then again with the ear one and they were about the same. She was sick once around teatime, just the once, and since then she has kept all her drinks down with no problems at all. She's drinking normaly, had her usual beaker of milk before bed and been asking for water in between, so no worries on that front. Her dad is working nights so I'm on my own with her this week and just wanted to check in properly rather than guessing. I've got calpol in the cuboard but havent given any yet as I wasnt sure about the timing with her being sick earlier. Let me know what you advise and I'll keep checking on her through the night.
